alert.headline: Special Weather Statement issued May 14 at 5:08PM HST by NWS Honolulu HI
alert.areas: Niihau; Kauai Southwest; Kauai Mountains; Waianae Coast; Oahu North Shore; Olomana; Central Oahu; Waianae Mountains; Lanai Mauka; Kahoolawe; Maui Windward West; Maui Leeward West; Haleakala Summit; Kauai North; Kauai East; Kauai South; East Honolulu; Honolulu Metro; Ewa Plain; Koolau Windward; Koolau Leeward; Molokai Windward; Molokai Southeast; Molokai North; Molokai West; Molokai Leeward South; Lanai Windward; Lanai Leeward; Lanai South; Maui Central Valley North; Maui Central Valley South; Windward Haleakala; Kipahulu; South Maui/Upcountry; South Haleakala
alert.desc:
An unseasonably strong upper low will move over the islands on
Friday, bringing in very unstable air for this time of year. This
will be enough for a few heavy showers or thundershowers to
develop in some spots. Most of these should be relatively brief,
so while widespread flash flooding is unlikely, ponding of water
in poor drainage areas, and maybe even some small hail, could
occur in a few of the heavier downpours Friday and Friday night.

alert.headline: Flood Watch issued May 15 at 1:35AM HST until May 15 at 6:00PM HST by NWS Honolulu HI
alert.areas: Niihau; Kauai Southwest; Kauai Mountains; Waianae Coast; Oahu North Shore; Olomana; Central Oahu; Waianae Mountains; Lanai Mauka; Kahoolawe; Maui Windward West; Maui Leeward West; Haleakala Summit; Kauai North; Kauai East; Kauai South; East Honolulu; Honolulu Metro; Ewa Plain; Koolau Windward; Koolau Leeward; Molokai Windward; Molokai Southeast; Molokai North; Molokai West; Molokai Leeward South; Lanai Windward; Lanai Leeward; Lanai South; Maui Central Valley North; Maui Central Valley South; Windward Haleakala; Kipahulu; South Maui/Upcountry; South Haleakala
alert.desc:
...FLOOD WATCH IN EFFECT THROUGH THIS AFTERNOON FOR MOST HAWAIIAN
ISLANDS...

* WHAT...Flash flooding caused by excessive rainfall is possible.

* WHERE...Niihau, Kauai, Oahu, Molokai, Lanai, Kahoolawe, and Maui.

* WHEN...Through this afternoon.

* IMPACTS...Flood prone roads and other low lying areas may be
closed due to elevated runoff and overflowing streams. Urban areas
may receive more significant flooding and property damage due to
rapid runoff.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- An unseasonably cold upper level low moving into the Hawaiian
Islands from the north will produce periods of heavy showers
across the island chain today. The center of the low will
settle in over Kauai around noon HST, the low will then
weaken and drift slowly eastward tonight. Unstable conditions
within this upper low will likely produce periods of
thunderstorms and heavy showers, potentially leading to flash
flooding conditions in some areas. This Flood Watch may need
to be extended into the overnight hours for some counties.
alert.instruction:
You should monitor later forecasts and be prepared to take action
should Flash Flood Warnings be issued.
